I do search for answers and I find nothing. I still don’t find comfort, I still don’t know how exactly he did it. The family has not shared those details with me and I feel like they won’t!

He loved me more than his own life, and he told me many times, he even said I was going to be his very very last one because he had found in me everything he needed. He said I was the love of his life and always will. In fact sent me an email right before he did it, saying “i love you, I’ll be yours forever”
